title: GroundTruthRecord
description: Provenance record for a single SBG benchmark pair label, implementing the four-tier ground-truth protocol defined in BENCHMARK_DESIGN.md §3.

base_id.description: Stem identifier of the base program file (e.g. 'sort_v1').

variant_id.description: Stem identifier of the variant / transformed program file.

transformation_type.description: Transformation taxonomy code, e.g. 'SP-3' or 'SC-2'. Prefix 'SP-' implies semantics-preserving; prefix 'SC-' implies semantics-changing.

gt_tier.description: Ground-truth tier. GT-T1 = formal proof (confidence ≥ 0.999); GT-T2 = exhaustive partition testing (≥ 0.990); GT-T3 = certified transformation + ≥ 1000 tests (≥ 0.950); GT-T4 = broad testing + expert review (≥ 0.900).

confidence.description: Calibrated confidence in the semantic_relation label. Must satisfy tier floor: GT-T1 ≥ 0.999, GT-T2 ≥ 0.990, GT-T3 ≥ 0.950, GT-T4 ≥ 0.900.

n_tests_run.description: Total number of input/output test pairs executed during differential testing.

n_divergent.description: Number of test inputs on which the two programs produced different observable outputs. Must be 0 for EQUIVALENT labels.

items.description: JSON-serialised representation of a divergent input.

divergent_examples.description: Up to 5 representative inputs on which divergence was observed (JSON strings). Empty for EQUIVALENT labels.

witness_input.description: The first input that produced a divergent output, or null if no divergence was observed.

validation_method.description: Machine-readable method identifier, e.g. 'certified_transformation_differential_testing', 'exhaustive_partition_differential_testing', 'differential_testing_witness_found', 'sc_type_taxonomy_no_witness'. May include the prefix 'sp_pair_divergence_alert_' when an SP-labelled pair produced unexpected divergence.

validator_version.description: Semantic version string of the validator that produced this record (e.g. '1.0.0').

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at which the record was produced (e.g. '2025-06-01T12:00:00+00:00').

oneOf.description: Path or URI to the formal proof artifact (GT-T1 only).

formal_proof_artifact.description: Path or URI to the stored formal proof object (GT-T1 only). Null for GT-T2 through GT-T4.

allOf.description: EQUIVALENT labels must have zero divergences.
